title: VisualShader crash when trying to add a value to enum of IntParameter
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in: Godot_v4.7-beta3, Godot_v4.7-beta2, Godot_v4.7-beta1 - Not reproducible in: Godot_v4.6.3-stable, Godot_v4.5.1-stable All these are win64 official builds. Works as expected in previous stable versions. ### System information Windows 11, Vulkan 1.4.329 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 ### Issue description Editor crashes when pressing `Add Element` of an Enum using the `IntParameter` node in the VisualShader. Crash log from my actual project which seems to indicate why: ``` --res://assets/tile_shader.tres-- 2 | render_mode blend_mix, depth_draw_opaque, depth_test_default, cull_back, diffuse_lambert, specular_schlick_ggx; 3 | E 4-> instance uniform int NeighborFlags : hint_enum() = 0; 5 | uniform uint LOD = 0; 6 | uniform sampler2D AlbedoFlat : source_color, filter_nearest_mipmap_anisotropic; SHADER ERROR: Expected a string constant. at: (null) (res://assets/tile_shader.tres:4) ERROR: Shader compilation failed. at: set_code (servers/rendering/renderer_rd/forward_clustered/scene_shader_forward_clustered.cpp:182) ERROR: Attempted to free invalid ID: 2264989658251325 at: _free_internal (servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:7724) ERROR: Attempted to free invalid ID: 2264981068316732 at: _free_internal (servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:7724) ERROR: Attempted to free invalid ID: 2264985363284027 at: _free_internal (servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:7724) ================================================================ CrashHandlerException: Program crashed with signal 11 Engine version: Godot Engine v4.7.beta3.official (86082170822e19ebb619c7f53c8fe54a6f8d3d2a) Dumping the backtrace.
